methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The aim of this exploratory study is to identify the major barriers to and drivers for energy management in industrial SMEs.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Exploratory questionnaire multiple-case study ranking barriers and drivers of energy management across 14 non-energy-intensive manufacturing SMEs, plus an energy-management maturity assessment. No EnPI/EnB measurement model is presented, proposed, evaluated, or characterised (variables/functional form/construction absent); 'energy performance indicators' is mentioned only incidentally as a collected data item. Falls under the v2.3 ineligibility rule for maturity/barriers-drivers studies without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content.

paper_type.evidence_quote: This study is based on a multiple case study that consists of 14 manufacturing SMEs located in Sweden.

stage1.notes: Ineligible: barriers/drivers + maturity questionnaire study of 14 manufacturing SMEs; no EnPI/EnB model characterised. Companies explicitly non-energy-intensive and outside continuous-process sectors (pulp & paper, iron & steel, cement, chemicals, petrochemicals), so level_3b not applicable.
